title: Sakthi Inventory
summary: Purchase to billing for a two-branch mobile shop, built to work for any retail business.
problem: The shop's third-party inventory software was expiring and could not be changed. Purchases, serial numbers, branch stock and billing needed to move to a system the business owned, without losing data.
solution: A multi-tenant inventory system with suppliers, purchases (GRN), central and branch stock, branch transfers, barcode billing and per-unit tracking, plus an import tool to move the old data across. A service and repair module is being added to replace the 2021 tracker.

features.title: Purchase to sale
features.description: Suppliers, GRN purchases and returns, stock ledger and barcode-scan billing.

features.title: Branch transfers
features.description: Send and receive stock between branches with a full trail.

features.title: Unit UID tracking
features.description: Every phone tracked by serial or IMEI from purchase to sale or return.

features.title: Label printing
features.description: A small Windows print bridge sends barcode labels to the shop's printer.

features.title: Data import
features.description: Categories, products and opening stock imported from the old software.

features.title: Roles per branch
features.description: Permission-based access, scoped to each user's branch.

aiNote: Built AI-first from a detailed PRD; each module followed the same template from schema to screens to tests.
results: Designed as a SaaS for any retail shop
Third system for the same client
